notes.title: Demo is LIVE, comrades! Your journey to chess mastery starts now
notes.notes:
[p]Hi, fellow chess enthusiast![/p][p]
The BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy demo has launched. Report to the training hall and test your mettle. Expect quick, focused puzzles, a clean scoring system where clean solves score higher, and hints that cost points. BOT.vinnik will roast your blunders and (begrudgingly) salute your brilliancies.[/p][h3]What’s inside the demo[/h3][p][b]Tactics 1 Module: 7 Chapters[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pin - Easy[/p][/*][*][p]Pin - Medium[/p][/*][*][p]Pin - Hard[/p][/*][*][p]Skewer - Easy[/p][/*][*][p]Skewer - Medium[/p][/*][*][p]Skewer - Hard[/p][/*][*][p]Fork - Easy[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Basics Mode: 8 Chapters[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rook[/p][/*][*][p]Bishop[/p][/*][*][p]Queen[/p][/*][*][p]King[/p][/*][*][p]Knight[/p][/*][*][p]Pawn[/p][/*][*][p]Check[/p][/*][*][p]Checkmate[/p][/*][/list][h3]Help us shape the full game[/h3][p]We are building this with you. In the Discussions, tell us:[/p][list][*][p]What did you enjoy most? concept explanations, pacing, challenge curve, BOT.vinnik’s reactions, scoring, UI[/p][/*][*][p]What would you like to see next? features, quality of life, difficulty options, accessibility, UI tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Which topics would you like us to cover in the full game? Tell us your priorities and interests.[/p][/*][/list][p]Huge thanks to everyone who shares feedback. It truly helps us make the best game possible.
If you like this first taste, please wishlist BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy, and send the demo link to that friend who would benefit from old-school chess coaching sessions. ♟️[/p]

notes.title: Incoming Transmission: BOT.VINNIK Demo Arrives August 28!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, fellow chess enthusiasts![/p][p][/p][p]The time has come: in just a few days (Thursday, August 28th) we’ll be releasing the [b]free demo[/b] of our brand-new game, [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/b].[/p][p]Here’s what awaits you inside the Academy:[/p][p]
♟️ [b]Hands-on Lessons[/b]. Puzzle-based training that actually teaches you how to play smarter.
🤖 [b]Sarcastic AI Coach[/b]. BOT.Vinnik returns with a sharper tongue and even sharper evaluations of your moves.
🐕 [b]Loyal Robo-Dog Laika[/b]. Because even the harshest instructors need a good cop by their side.
🎓 [b]Academy Vibes[/b]. An immersive retro-futuristic environment that makes learning chess feel like an adventure.[/p][p][/p][p]Mark your calendars: [b]Demo goes live Thursday, August 28th[/b].
Don’t forget to [b]Wishlist & Follow[/b] the game to be notified the moment it drops![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support. We can’t wait to hear your feedback once you survive your first training session.[/p][p]The Deep Green Games Team[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Playtest extended until August 10—join directly via Steam Playtest! 🎉
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]First of all, thank you so much for playing BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy! The response and feedback we've received so far have been amazing, and we’re beyond grateful.[/p][p]Because of your great participation (and some friendly demands 😉), we’ve decided to extend the Playtest period until [b]August 10th[/b].[/p][p]Our goal with BOT.VINNIK is to create [b]the ultimate chess improvement platform[/b]—the kind of chess game you’ve always wanted. To do this, your feedback is absolutely essential. Every opinion helps us fine-tune puzzles, features, and overall game feel.[/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 How to Join the Playtest?[/h3][p]Simply head over to our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy"]Steam page[/url] and hit the "[b]Request Access[/b]" or "[b]Join the Playtest[/b]" button. notes.title: Announce Trailer & Steam Page Now Live
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello, comrades![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re Rodrigo & Eduardo from Deep Green Games, and after months of enduring BOT.VINNIK’s relentless sarcasm and zero patience, we’re proud to announce: [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy is now live on Steam![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The game is still in training—but very soon, a [b]free demo[/b] will be available. You’ll get to explore the academy, tackle a few clever puzzles, and experience our grumpy coach's unique teaching style firsthand.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback is [i]vital[/i] (before BOT.VINNIK declares humanity a lost cause). Feel free to share your thoughts anytime![/p][p][/p][p]Also: have you seen our [b]Reveal Trailer[/b] yet? BOT.VINNIK insists it qualifies for a Grandmaster title. Watch it below—and if it makes you chuckle or nod in respect, don’t forget to [b]Wishlist[/b] the game![/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/58g7isfKb8k"]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy announce trailer[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for the support—and for putting up with our electronic mentor.[/p][p][/p][p]See you at the Academy! [/p][p]Rodrigo & Eduardo Deep Green Games[/p]
